name: Goblin Link
description: Your AI agent on the Brick: Muse, or a Hermes Agent you run yourself. Chat and voice notes (and calls with Muse), and it can build tools and games for the handheld. Needs a Muse account or your own Hermes.
author: travis-mcdevitt

changelog.v0.1.0-rc.3: Hermes Agent as a second kind of agent: pair with a link, run its commands from Y, hear its replies, and see what a voice note said. Pairing asks which agent first. Reply buttons need no switch. One colour sets bubbles and accent. Review fixes to grants, files, installs and tokens.
changelog.v0.1.0-rc.2: Native Muse choices and D-pad fixes, accurate typing state, Ask first for build installs, standalone game Paks and launch diagnostics, NextUI sleep/wake, and profile/pairing recovery.
changelog.v0.1.0-rc.1: First release candidate for TrimUI Brick on NextUI. Includes reviewed permission, profile, voice and input fixes. Hardware validation pending.
